newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Dec new motor vehicle sales rise 5.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Dec new motor vehicle sales rise 5.1 pct.

text.p: New motor vehicle sales rose 5.1 percent seasonally adjusted in December to 112,520 units from an upwardly revised 107,039 units (105,165 units) in November, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a 6.6 percent rise in December.
For all of 1996, new motor vehicle sales rose 3.3 percent from 1995, to 1,204,557 units.
Statistics Canada said that despite the year-over-year increase, 1996 sales were below the 1994 level.
